title: SKE Crystal Pro Blue Razz Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Designed for use with the SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pods offer a seamless way to enjoy outstanding flavour and satisfaction without the waste and expense caused by single-use disposables. Each prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on individual usage, and contains 2ml of 20mg nic salt e-liquid, providing a smooth, satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape with rapid nicotine relief. Blue Razz Lemonade blends the bold, syrupy sweetness of blue raspberry with the sharp, citrus sparkle of classic lemonade. The result is a fizzy, tangy vape that balances rich berry notes with a zesty citrus kick, finishing with a crisp, refreshing exhale. Swapping pods is quick and effortless—simply remove the empty pod and pop a fresh one into place. Whether you're looking for a convenient alternative to disposables or a simple way to continue enjoying your favourite SKE Crystal Pro 600 flavours, these prefilled pods provide an affordable, mess-free, and hassle-free solution.
